consistency.label: Active shipping weeks and push-hour spread

validation.method: event-level: GitHub PR API merged_at + merged_by
validation.notes: Each checked merge event must exist, have merged_at inside the window, and have merged_by.login equal to the ranked account. Unknown (404/private) events are excluded from the rate, never counted as matches.

notes: `source` describes how much of the public GitHub event stream this window actually contains (hourly files downloaded, events seen, bot events skipped). gharchive.org is a partial mirror of public events, so the ranking covers the activity it observed, not every commit on GitHub. Automation signals (commit-message entropy and PR changed-file counts) are only known when the feed carries them; unknown signals are disclosed here and never turned into a guessed adjustment. Missing pillars are excluded from the weighted score and the remaining weights are renormalised.
